map.欧姆定律 V = I·R，选择求解量（电压 / 电流 / 电阻），填入已知两量，: Ohm's law V = I x R: choose which quantity to solve for (voltage / current / resistance), enter the two known quantities, and it solves automatically and gives derived quantities such as power P = VI and conductance.
map.（电压 = 电流 × 电阻）。派生量：功率 P = V·I，电导 G = 1/R: (voltage = current x resistance). Derived quantities: power P = V x I, conductance G = 1/R.
map.选择要解的未知量（电压 / 电流 / 电阻）单选。: Choose the unknown to solve for (voltage / current / resistance) with a radio button.
map.填入另外两个已知量。: Fill in the other two known quantities.
map.结果区显示求解量、功率、电导与电荷量。: The result area shows the solved quantity, power, conductance and charge.
map.家电电流估算（已知电压与电阻求电流）。: Home appliance current estimation (finding current from known voltage and resistance).
map.求解电阻时电流不能为 0（否则除零）；电阻单位默认 Ω，注意 kΩ/MΩ 换算。: When solving for resistance the current cannot be 0 (that would divide by zero); the resistance unit defaults to ohms, so watch kΩ/MΩ conversions.
map.选错求解量怎么办？: What if I choose the wrong unknown?
map.切换单选按钮并重新填入已知两量即可。: Switch the radio button and re-enter the two known quantities.
map.功率 P=VI 用于判断元器件发热与额定功率是否匹配。: Power P = VI is used to judge whether component heating matches the rated power.
